scope: Post-B0 exploratory calibration and equalization factorial gate; no formal holdout claim
split_rule: Each complete history and all 191 target positions must be inside its raw time block; all candidates use the same anchors based on max history 32. No random window split.
observations: Only previously available NoPred samples at pilot times. Dense true CSI is used only as training labels, scoring, or explicitly marked oracle statistics.
selection: Per-case history and ridge chosen on validation only, minimizing equal-weight RX and TX NMSE; RX horizons 0..127, TX horizons weighted by uniform start phase 0..127 and 64 transmission positions.
oracle_rule: genie_acf uses biased autocorrelation from the diagnostic test raw block, fixed history 32/ridge 1e-6. genie_empirical uses least squares fit and evaluation on the same diagnostic test, history 32. Neither is deployable or a general information-theoretic bound.
ar1_rule: AR(1) coefficient estimated from consecutive training pilots, modulus clipped to 1. Fractional-horizon continuation uses the principal complex logarithm; no hidden dense-history input.

e2e.image_selection: One image per scene, then deterministic SHA256 ranking; use validation images only.
e2e.noise: Common normalized complex Gaussian draws by channel, image, start, seed across policies and SNRs; per-image power normalization and permutation scoring via referenced validated adapter.
e2e.metadata: Keep true CSI, speed and actual ages fixed for all causal policies. ideal_same_metadata changes CSI only; ideal_zero_age additionally changes ages and is a separate oracle diagnostic. Weights never change.
e2e.compute_time: Measure prediction and codec time. This pilot fixes the transmission timeline to isolate CSI estimation; it does not yet advance the physical trace by compute latency or claim real-time deployment.
e2e.gate_scope: Exploratory diagnostic evidence only; no B2/full-run claim from this 32-image pilot. This diagnostic channel holdout becomes development evidence after inspection.

b01.calibration: Validation pilots 600:800 only; no diagnostic_test labels. This is reused validation data, not an independent calibration split.
b01.equalizer: g=conj(hhat)/(abs(hhat)^2 + validation_error_variance[horizon] + 10^(-SNR/10)); applied equally to hold and predictors.
b01.images: Same fixed 32 B0 validation scenes for every noise seed.
b01.decision: Report all arms and per-seed differences; no automatic selection on these development outcomes or automatic full training.
